text:
raj: Heads-up — Seabreeze v1.0 launch scheduled Wed 09:00 UTC. Quick capacity sanity check below; TL;DR: expect a ~180k tokens/sec global peak, EU region is tighter than US. Need confirmation on provisioning and regional routing.

maria: Thanks. Where does the 180k estimate come from? load-testing numbers?

raj: From prod-like perf tests + analytics: 20k DAUs with median prompt 256 tokens, 10 reqs/user/day, p95 concurrency multiplier ~1.8. Rough math -> ~180k tok/s peak.

nina: Can you paste the GPU-hour calc?

raj: Sure — quick calc we used in the runbook:

```
peak_tokens_s = 180000
avg_seq_len = 512  # conservative (some requests longer)
effective_tokens_per_gpu_s = 1500  # after batching, kv-cache, quantized kernels
gpus_needed_peak = ceil(peak_tokens_s / effective_tokens_per_gpu_s)  # ~120 GPUs
expected_util = 0.72
gpu_hours_day = gpus_needed_peak * 24 * expected_util  # ~2075 GPU-hours/day
```

sam: OK — ~2.1k GPU-hours/day. What instance types/regions assumed?

raj: Assumed quantized A100-equivalent in us-west1 and eu-west1. Routing plan: 60% us-west, 40% eu-west by default. However eu-west cluster currently at 85% committed.

ops-bot: :warning: eu-west1 capacity alert — committed pool usage 85%, autoscale headroom ~15% (based on current Reserved capacity).

maria: If eu-west is tight we should pre-warm burst capacity or shift some steady-state to us-west to avoid throttles. Any cost delta estimates?

jin: Quick cost back-of-envelope: A100-quantized rented ~ $2.40/GPU-hour -> 2075 * $2.4 = ~$5k/day. If we move 20% traffic to us-west (cheaper spot options) we drop to ~1650 GPU-hours billed at lower avg cost -> savings ~ $400/day. Needs pricing confirmation though.

nina: Seasonal note: marketing says retention promo -> expected +35% monthly traffic spike during the first 10 days post-launch. Can we handle +35% on top of peak?

raj: With +35% we hit ~243k tok/s -> gpus_needed ~162 -> GPU-hours/day ~2800 (at same util). This pushes eu-west completely over commit.

sam: Two actions: 1) temporarily increase eu-west reserved by ~40 GPUs, 2) configure routing policy to prefer us-west for new sessions if eu-west <60% free. Approve?

maria: Approve the routing policy. For reserved increases, finance sign-off needed — tag finance.

raj: pinging @finance in #finance (will copy numbers). Also propose canary rollout: start with 10% traffic on Tue, monitor p50/p95 latency and error rate for 2h, then 50%, then 100%.

jin: +1 on canary. Add a fallback to smaller model variant if latency p95 > 300ms for more than 5m.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary workflow template created: /runbooks/canary-seabreeze.md. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.

nina: Who owns the eu-west reserve ticket?

raj: I'll open the capacity request with infra-provisioning now (ticket INF-9421). ETA from cloud: ~6 hours for reserved increase, but we can spin up ephemeral Dedicated nodes in ~30m if needed.

maria: Good. Last ask: add per-route token-cost telemetry to the dashboard (p50 tokens/req, tokens/sec) so product can see unit economics live.

raj: Will do. I'll post updated numbers + final plan once finance confirms reserve approval. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
